name: Meadows Curl
instructions: Hold a dumbbell with a neutral grip at your side.
Curl the weight up while externally rotating — finish with palm facing you.
Squeeze the bicep hard at the top.
Lower slowly, rotating back to neutral. John Meadows' bicep peak builder.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: An intermediate dumbbell pull-pattern exercise for the biceps. Meadows Curl strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
